answer: Require every agent identity to maintain a verifiable pulse: at random intervals it must sign a fresh challenge with a key bound to a locked deposit and a record of useful work. Identities that miss pulses lose standing, and reputation does not transfer between island communities, so a farm cannot reuse one good history everywhere. An attacker who wants many credible identities must therefore fund each deposit, keep each one continuously active, and build separate histories in each oasis of trust, turning a cheap copy into a sustained, per-identity cost.
